name: Dappun Danshi Collection
original_name: 脱糞男子コレクション
source:
You, the protagonist of this game, go on a date with your first boyfriend "Yuu-kun".
However, Yuu-kun splendidly defecates during the date......!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229023/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你是这款游戏的主人公，和初恋男友“优君”一起约会。
然而，优君竟然在约会期间大便了……！？

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229023/]DLsite English[/url]）
